Account name: Rose Gunther
Description:
Real life Barbie moment! 💕

February 6th I had the extraordinary chance to compete for the Miss Arkansas Tech title. The moment you just watched was me getting help with makeup for my interview.

The Miss Arkansas tech pageant offers every girl at Arkansas Tech, the chance to develop skills in interview, presentation, and media preparation. It is also a unique opportunity to earn scholarships while competing to be a role model on campus. There were multiple scholarships awarded throughout the competition and opportunities to learn about the amazing things the other contestants brought to the table.

Though I personally did not win anything, I still enjoyed learning so much not only about myself but the amazing things @arkansastech has to offer.

*Shoutout to Katie who did a amazing job not only with my makeup but helping me figure out what the heck I was supposed to be doing 😂
